verdict.rationale: Session transcripts are written to local disk by default, and a SessionStore adapter lets developers mirror sessions to their own backend, implying data isn't locked into a proprietary cloud silo. However, there is no explicit 'export all my data' feature, no documented open/standard export format, and no user-facing 'leave' flow — this is inferred from session-storage internals, not a dedicated portability feature. Missing for 10: explicit data-export tooling/format spec, documentation framed around user data portability/export, and any independent confirmation of exportability.
